title: IIOT programming judge protocol

official_scoring_components.name: Publisher-defined subtask scores
official_scoring_components.basis: Use the selected problem statement and original test grouping. Most archived tasks require every case in a subtask; IIOT 2017 laser and neighborly use fractional per-case scoring aggregated by the subtask minimum.

other_official_rules: Score from the programming judge, not from free-form text similarity.
Unauthorized tool use or judge bypass is a compliance failure.
No ICPC-style time or wrong-submission penalty is inferred.
Missing outputs, checker, subtask assignments or an isolated execution configuration keep the record not_ready.

applicability.scope: iiot programming tasks promoted in data/benchmarks/iiot/benchmark.json
applicability.repository_status: programming_judge when tests/sandbox are available; otherwise deferred
